Blend into lossless when a better copy of the playing song is found

Auris will start the better copy on a second decoder and blend the last two seconds instead of briefly pausing. If the two recordings come from different masters, the overlap can sound doubled or phased. The extra decoder also costs a little CPU for those two seconds.
